reader.requirement: In a format 1 SEARCH without VARYING, the compiler must scan with the first (or only) index-name of identifier-1's INDEXED BY phrase and leave every other index-name of identifier-1 unchanged, on a successful and an unsuccessful (AT END) search, for fixed and occurs-depending tables.
